7:2600.name: I had an idea to preserve and share audio recordings from my father-in-law about his time serving as a Captain on the San Diego Fire Department. They ranged from heart-breaking personal tragedies and accidents to hilarious and silly moments. I have always admired the ability of firefighters to operate within the crossroads of human experience with such humility and compassion. His stories are a reflection of that.
